question: Can the only authorised immutable 4.7.2 current-default cache identify the selected multiple-events-multiple-targets predicate exactly enough to apply a frozen natural-capacity screen?
scientificBasis: The selected representation is card-scoped and target-specific. Exact capacity therefore requires a PLAY identity, every SHATTER event emitted before that card terminates, each SHATTER enemy idx and the terminal event for the same card uid. Aggregate fight Shatters or a list of played cards cannot attribute a Shatter to a card or distinguish one target from multiple targets. Observability is a fail-fast precondition before support access.

selectedRepresentation.exactPredicate: Within one PLAY-to-card-terminal event window, SHATTER event count is at least two and the set of SHATTER idx values has size at least two.

eligibleEvidence.rowSelection: Only the 256 explicit-flare rows from the immutable Lantern-Art capacity output. Beacon rows are excluded. The rows are the frozen policyRoot 421901, policy indices 0 through 63 and simulation seeds 421910 through 421913, Duskblade, Vow 5, exact source c4130163c7fb8edd865c0adc95732aae03e1bad2 and authored current-default Flare.
eligibleEvidence.identityAuthority: The preceding Lantern trace-null sentinel proved the added trace arrays preserve omitted-versus-explicit-Flare complete identity. This screen adds no field and may not repair or reinterpret that projection.
eligibleEvidence.forbidden: Beacon rows, 4.7.1 outputs, failed-identity outputs, protected seeds, ledger endpoints, V30 adaptive evidence and every other cache object.

sourceTraceProjection.aliasFailure: fights.shatters is an aggregate over the complete fight. It cannot identify the producing PLAY, the number of distinct targets, same-target repeats, Art or relic-produced Shatters, or a card-terminal boundary.

eventParser.windowConstruction: Within each fight, sort PLAY, SHATTER and terminal events by the immutable queue event index. Open a window at PLAY(fight,event,id,uid). Close only on TO_DISCARD, EXHAUST or POWER_CONSUMED with the same uid. Reject overlapping, unterminated, duplicated or out-of-order windows. Count SHATTER events strictly after PLAY and before its matching terminal; preserve every integer idx.
eventParser.rowActivation: A row is active when at least one valid card window contains at least two SHATTER events and at least two distinct integer idx values.
eventParser.carrierIdentity: The carrier is the PLAY id for each active window. No card ID, rarity, act, formation or outcome subset is permitted.
eventParser.failClosed: Any missing required field, malformed event, unpaired terminal or ambiguous attribution fails observability before support is read or counted.

scoreline.definition: A robust policy plays Chisel before a later Faultline in one fight in at least two of four eligible rows.
scoreline.status: Separate activation anchor only; Scoreline payoff is absent and no interference effect is estimated.

afterimage.definition: A robust policy plays Ward before a later Warden's Edge in one fight in at least two of four eligible rows.
afterimage.status: Separate activation anchor only; Afterimage payoff is absent and no interference effect is estimated.

estimands.activePolicy: At least two of four rows activate the exact multi-enemy-card-Shatter predicate.
estimands.exactInactivePolicy: None of four rows activates the predicate.
estimands.viablePolicy: An active policy has at least one winning row that activates the predicate.
estimands.carrierBreadth: Number of distinct exact PLAY card IDs producing an active window anywhere in the eligible rectangle.
estimands.functionalSeparation: Candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard policy counts against Scoreline and Afterimage separately on the same rows.
estimands.reliability: Count rows whose outcome is stall or error or whose error field is non-empty.
estimands.notEstimated: No payoff, causal effect, policy optimisation, detector, protected seed, product candidate or cross-package interference effect is estimated.

gates.provenance: The 16 active and inactive, eight viable, two-carrier, separate eight-policy anchor and 0.55 overlap gates reuse the frozen 64-policy capacity scale. One baseline fault is the unchanged current-main reliability ceiling.

stopping.order: Validate immutable source, evidence, ledger and exact trace projection. If any parser field is unavailable, stop at futility without opening the cache. Only a fully observable projection may open exactly one cache object and apply every gate at one fixed first look.
stopping.noRetry: One attempt. Do not add telemetry, repair the trace, substitute aggregate Shatters, infer targets from card identity, change the window, inspect another cache, weaken a gate or rerun.

decisionRules.success: The source projection supplies every exact parser field and the single eligible 256-row first look passes every support, inactivity, viability, carrier, separate-anchor and reliability gate.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only the multi-enemy-card-Shatter representation for a separately preregistered identity-safe payoff/carrier study. Do not choose its payoff from this capacity data, implement, add a row, use a method or protected seed.
decisionRules.futility: The authorised cache projection cannot identify the exact predicate, or any fixed capacity gate fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close the complete multi-enemy-card-Shatter topology without telemetry repair, aggregate proxy, alternate cache, card subset, payoff, carrier, implementation or rerun. Continue issue #421 with the next source- and evidence-backed structural mechanism.
decisionRules.inconclusive: An immutable input, cache identity, ledger identity or wall-time condition prevents the preregistered decision without an identified fixed failure.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the capacity screen inconclusive at cap without trace repair, cache substitution, row extension, implementation or inference.
